name: the engine's own draws
why: Under rng=replay a draw one game's engine makes and the other's does not has no twin to be replayed from: each is named in legit.json's rng, only, by its game and its caller's range, with both games' routines; neither is the family's (a draw its code led to is never masked). The next draw the replay matches writes the words alike again.
evidence: legit.json, rng, only: each draw's routines in both games
